references.title: DWDS: erst
references.supports: Adverb with no Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: from the ordinal erster, a superlative of the comparative behind eher

notes.rationale: Erst klang es, 'at first'. It goes back to a West Germanic superlative, *airista-, whose -st no German affix list holds, and DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, an indeclinable one with no Ending (ADR 0051): the Root erst alone.
